description: Protocol 5.3 recovery scenarios: pair PC/phone, PC removes phone, phone retains old log, both confirm a fresh QR. 'readmit': expect a signed add after the remove and matching logs. 'revoked' (reason 1, lost-or-stolen, 4.3 set R): the display closes with PAIR_REVOKED before the SAS and the log is unchanged; the same phone with a new identity then pairs as a new device. No new wire encoding.
